text:
This notice should be read with Part 6 of the merchant shipping (maritime labour convention) (minimum requirements for Seafarers etc.) regulations 2014 (“the MLC minimum requirements regulations”) and replaces MGN 479 (M).

Amendment 1 refers to the guidance in MGN 477 amendment 4 on the maximum period of sea service, includes additional guidance on the costs of quarantine, and other minor editorial changes for clarification.

Notice to

shipowners

ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers and seafarers on sea-going ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations.
